source.video_title: HOW TO View PowerPoint Notes While Sharing Screen on Zoom (Presenter View Hack)

analysis:
### 1. High-level Design Pattern Extraction

> **Skill Name**: SaaS Promotional Hero Layout

* **Core Visual Mechanism**: A clean, high-contrast, two-column "hero" layout typical of modern software platforms (like the Zoom dashboard seen in the video). It relies on massive white space, a prominent, high-contrast CTA (Call to Action) pill button, and a balanced split between left-aligned typography and a right-aligned conceptual illustration/mockup.
* **Why Use This Skill (Rationale)**: This is the undisputed standard for conversion-optimized visual communication. The Z-pattern reading order naturally drops the viewer's eye from the brand logo, down through the value proposition, landing squarely on the CTA button. It minimizes cognitive load while appearing premium and trustworthy.
* **Overall Applicability**: Perfect for product launch slides, internal company offers, marketing presentations, and portfolio landing pages.
* **Value Addition**: Transforms a standard bullet-point slide into a landing-page-quality promotional banner. It forces conciseness (one main message, one action) and elevates the professional tier of the deck.

### 2. Visual Breakdown

* **Step A: Core Visual Elements**
  - **Background**: Pure white `(255, 255, 255)` or a very subtle off-white to allow graphics to pop.
  - **Typography & Color Logic**: 
    - Title: Bold, heavy weight, dark charcoal `(31, 35, 40)`.
    - Body: Regular weight, accessible gray `(101, 109, 118)`.
    - Brand/Accent: Bright SaaS Blue `(11, 92, 255)` used sparingly (only on the logo and the CTA button) to direct attention.
  - **CTA Button**: A perfect "pill" shape (rounded rectangle with 50% border radius) containing bold, white text.

* **Step B: Compositional Style**
  - **Split Layout**: A strict ~45/55 horizontal split. The text takes up the left 45%, leaving the right 55% as a generous canvas for visual anchoring (illustrations or app mockups).
  - **Vertical Alignment**: The text block (Title + Body + Button) is perfectly vertically centered within the slide canvas, creating a sense of grounded stability.

* **Step C: Dynamic Effects & Transitions**
  - **Static Presentation**: This layout relies on static visual hierarchy rather than animation. The high-contrast CTA naturally draws the eye without needing motion.

### 3. Reproduction Code

#### 3a. Implementation Method Selection

| Aspect of the effect | Method | Why this method |
|---|---|---|
| **Text Hierarchy & Layout** | `python-pptx` native | Cleanest and most maintainable way to position standard text boxes and control font sizes/colors. |
| **Perfect Pill CTA Button** | `lxml` XML injection | Native `python-pptx` shapes cannot explicitly set corner radius values to achieve a perfect semi-circle end ("pill" shape). We must inject the `<a:gd name="adj" fmla="val 50000"/>` tag directly into the OOXML. |
| **Right-side Illustration** | `PIL/Pillow` | Since we don't have the source vector graphics, we generate a polished, programmatic "App Dashboard Mockup" as a transparent PNG to serve as the visual anchor. |

> **Feasibility Assessment**: 100%. The code accurately reproduces the modern, clean structural aesthetic of the SaaS promotional screen shown in the tutorial, complete with programmatic vector-style placeholder graphics.

#### 3b. Complete Reproduction Code

```python
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.oxml import OxmlElement
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

def create_slide(
    output_pptx_path: str,
    title_text: str = "Limited time offer!",
    body_text: str = "Take an additional 15% off when you upgrade to the Pro annual plan. Terms apply.",
    bg_palette: str = "tech",
    accent_color: tuple = (11, 92, 255),  # Zoom-style SaaS Blue
    **kwargs,
) -> str:
    """
    Create a PPTX file reproducing the SaaS Promotional Hero Layout.
    """
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # Blank layout

    # Background color (Clean White)
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)

    # --- 1. Top Left Brand Logo ---
    logo_size = Inches(0.4)
    logo_shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, 
        Inches(1.0), Inches(0.8), logo_size, logo_size
    )
    logo_shape.fill.solid()
    logo_shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(230, 235, 250)
    logo_shape.line.fill.background()
    
    logo_frame = logo_shape.text_frame
    logo_frame.text = "m"
    p = logo_frame.paragraphs[0]
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.size = Pt(20)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(*accent_color)
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # --- 2. Left Column: Text Hierarchy ---
    # Title
    title_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.0), Inches(2.2), Inches(5.0), Inches(1.0))
    title_tf = title_box.text_frame
    title_tf.word_wrap = True
    title_p = title_tf.add_paragraph()
    title_p.text = title_text
    title_p.font.size = Pt(44)
    title_p.font.bold = True
    title_p.font.name = "Arial"
    title_p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(31, 35, 40)

    # Body
    body_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.0), Inches(3.4), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.5))
    body_tf = body_box.text_frame
    body_tf.word_wrap = True
    body_p = body_tf.add_paragraph()
    body_p.text = body_text
    body_p.font.size = Pt(18)
    body_p.font.name = "Arial"
    body_p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(101, 109, 118)

    # --- 3. CTA Pill Button (lxml injection for 50% border radius) ---
    btn_width = Inches(1.8)
    btn_height = Inches(0.6)
    btn = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, 
        Inches(1.0), Inches(4.8), btn_width, btn_height
    )
    btn.fill.solid()
    btn.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(*accent_color)
    btn.line.fill.background()
    
    # Text
    btn_tf = btn.text_frame
    btn_tf.clear()
    btn_p = btn_tf.paragraphs[0]
    btn_p.text = "Get offer"
    btn_p.font.size = Pt(16)
    btn_p.font.bold = True
    btn_p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
    btn_p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # LXML Injection: Modify shape geometry to make it a perfect pill
    prstGeom = btn.element.xpath('.//a:prstGeom')[0]
    avLst = prstGeom.find(qn('a:avLst'))
    if avLst is None:
        avLst = OxmlElement('a:avLst')
        prstGeom.append(avLst)
    gd = OxmlElement('a:gd')
    gd.set('name', 'adj')
    gd.set('fmla', 'val 50000')  # 50,000 = 50% radius (pill)
    avLst.append(gd)

    # --- 4. Right Side: Generate SaaS Product Mockup Illustration via PIL ---
    temp_img_path = "temp_mockup_illustration.png"
    
    # Create high-res canvas
    mockup_size = (1200, 1000)
    mockup_img = Image.new('RGBA', mockup_size, (255, 255, 255, 0))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mockup_img)
    
    # Soft background aesthetic blob
    blob_color = (accent_color[0], accent_color[1], accent_color[2], 30) # Light tint
    draw.ellipse([100, 50, 1100, 950], fill=blob_color)
    
    # App Window Outline
    app_bg = (255, 255, 255, 255)
    app_stroke = (220, 225, 230, 255)
    draw.rounded_rectangle([200, 150, 1000, 850], radius=30, fill=app_bg, outline=app_stroke, width=4)
    
    # App Header
    header_color = (245, 247, 250, 255)
    draw.rounded_rectangle([200, 150, 1000, 240], radius=30, fill=header_color)
    # Square bottom corners of header to blend
    draw.rectangle([200, 210, 1000, 240], fill=header_color)
    draw.line([200, 240, 1000, 240], fill=app_stroke, width=4)
    
    # Header UI dots (traffic lights)
    draw.ellipse([230, 185, 250, 205], fill=(255, 95, 86, 255))
    draw.ellipse([270, 185, 290, 205], fill=(255, 189, 46, 255))
    draw.ellipse([310, 185, 330, 205], fill=(39, 201, 63, 255))
    
    # Content bars representing UI layout
    # Main hero block
    draw.rounded_rectangle([280, 320, 600, 360], radius=20, fill=(220, 225, 235, 255))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([280, 400, 920, 420], radius=10, fill=(240, 243, 248, 255))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([280, 450, 850, 470], radius=10, fill=(240, 243, 248, 255))
    draw.rounded_rectangle([280, 500, 700, 520], radius=10, fill=(240, 243, 248, 255))
    
    # Content Graphic/Chart representation
    draw.rounded_rectangle([650, 300, 920, 380], radius=20, fill=blob_color)
    
    # Mock Button inside the app
    draw.rounded_rectangle([280, 600, 480, 660], radius=30, fill=(*accent_color, 255))
    
    # Save and Insert
    mockup_img.save(temp_img_path)
    slide.shapes.add_picture(temp_img_path, Inches(6.5), Inches(1.0), Inches(6.0))
    
    # Cleanup temp image
    if os.path.exists(temp_img_path):
        os.remove(temp_img_path)

    prs.save(output_pptx_path)
    return output_pptx_path
```
